jei.simplechisels.note.forward: Right-click the block with the chisel
simplechisels.guide.page.1.title: Simple Chisels
simplechisels.guide.page.1: Seven chisels from Stone to Enderite that turn a block into the next one of its family right where it stands - stone into chiseled stone bricks,
simplechisels.guide.page.2.title: Simple Chisels
simplechisels.guide.page.2: planks into stairs - and back again when you sneak, and the enchantment Fast Chiseling.
simplechisels.guide.page.3.title: Chisels: the next block of the family
simplechisels.guide.page.3: Seven chisels from Stone to Enderite. A right-click turns the block into the next one of its chain right where it stands - stone into chiseled stone bricks, planks into stairs, stairs into slabs;
simplechisels.guide.page.4.title: Chisels: the next block of the family
simplechisels.guide.page.4: sneak + right-click walks the chain one step back and costs 2 durability instead of 1.
simplechisels.guide.page.5.title: Fast Chiseling
simplechisels.guide.page.5: The chisel enchantment (levels I and II, also at the enchanting table): the cooldown after a step drops to 70 % (I) or 40 % (II), never below one tick, and the chisel mines faster (like Efficiency II or IV).
simplechisels.guide.page.6.title: Chisel tables as data
simplechisels.guide.page.6: Every chain is a datapack file data/<namespace>/chisel_transformations/<name>.json with a tier (stone, iron, diamond, netherite, enderite), a table (chisel, or touch for Constructor's Touch), chains of block ids
simplechisels.guide.page.7.title: Chisel tables as data
simplechisels.guide.page.7: (optionally cyclic) and an optional remove list. Simple Chisels ships the Vanilla chains; other mods add their own blocks the same way.
simplechisels.guide.page.8.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplechisels.guide.page.8: The seven chisels, Fast Chiseling, the ten chisel recipes and their recipe unlocks were SimpleBuilding's (simplebuilding:*). Old worlds load them under simplechisels:* through SimpleLib's id moves and save the new ids;
simplechisels.guide.page.9.title: Moved from SimpleBuilding
simplechisels.guide.page.9: the six legacy spatulas become the chisel of their tier, in chests and unloaded chunks too.
simplechisels.guide.page.10.title: Creative tab
simplechisels.guide.page.10: The chisels and the Fast Chiseling books sit in the tab Simple Chisels only (no Vanilla tabs).
simplechisels.guide.page.11.title: Commands
simplechisels.guide.page.11: /simplechisels config shows and changes every option of config/simplechisels-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplechisels.guide.page.12.title: Commands
simplechisels.guide.page.12: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once. Permission level 2.
simplechisels.guide.page.13.title: Settings
simplechisels.guide.page.13: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
